What the game code does: Fires only at matching-colour rocks, skipping gems, ingots and jackpots. Adds $1 per hit, or $2 if the rock is ignited. Stops when the rock reaches its cap: 4 x face (whole rock = $4; crushed half = $3.50).
Notes: The floating x2/x3/x4 popup shows the rock's new total value, not the $1 added by that hit.

What the game code does: Works twice as fast: double the hit frequency, same $1/$2 per hit.

Does not add money itself. Sets tagged = true on a whole or crushed rock. The next matching-colour laser hit then adds $2 instead of $1, and clears the tag. Refuses to ignite if the rock has less than about $1 of room left under its cap.
Notes: Vanilla rate is 3 rocks/s; the mod retimes the live simulation when upgraded.

What the game code does: Mod sets the live belt ignition delay to 1/4.5 s and the machine card shows 4.5 rocks/s.
Notes: Requires the RefinerySim.Tick postfix and RefineryScreen.Numbers postfix in IgniterPatches.

What the game code does: Mod sets the live belt ignition delay to 1/6 s and the machine card shows 6 rocks/s.
Notes: Requires the RefinerySim.Tick postfix and RefineryScreen.Numbers postfix in IgniterPatches.

What the game code does: Splits a whole rock into two halves: each gets value x 0.5 and face x 0.5. Lasers can hit both halves, and each half has a $3.50 cap, so one original rock can now pay up to $7 from lasers instead of $4.
Takes rocks off the belt and pays them at face value immediately. Every 10 rocks produces an ingot worth an extra 20% of that batch's value.
Notes: Batch size and bonus scale with level.

What the game code does: Only touches pristine rocks (no hits, no tag, not split or rolled). 1 in 8 becomes a gem worth 5x its current value. Gems are then immune to every other machine.
Kicks a pristine, never-touched rock back to the start of the lane for one extra pass. No value change; it just gives lasers/crusher a second chance.
Notes: Each rock is kicked only once.

What the game code does: Rolls every 5 s; 1 in 10 arms it. The next eligible rock becomes a jackpot worth 10x its current value. This can multiply a rock that lasers have already raised. Gems and ingots are skipped.
Available from tier 4. Sends one colour down its lane; maximum lanes - 1, so one lane stays unsorted.
